exposure: recombinant human BMP-2 (rhBMP-2) intravenously administered at 0.05 mg/kg/day
recombinant human BMP-2 (rhBMP-2) intravenously administered at 0.15 mg/kg/day
recombinant human BMP-2 (rhBMP-2) intravenously administered at 0.50 mg/kg/day
cohort: 176 male and female rats (88 each) were divided into one control and three experimental groups.
finding: Recombinant human BMP-2 (rhBMP-2) administered to rats showed no reproductive toxicity on reproductive performance, organs, fertility, and early embryonic development, with a no-observed-adverse-effect level of 0.50 mg/kg/day.
